opening.argument: The presentation solicits paid participation in Bitcoin-mining shares and a lifetime membership while promising recurring earnings: buyers receive “a piece of the money every day,” and may receive “two or three Bitcoins” in each of several successive years. The displayed mining tiers include dollar prices and Buy Now buttons, while separate materials promote level-up bonuses and a binary team cycle with left and right teams. Participation is also framed around private invitation even as the displayed service notice says the network is unavailable in the United States. Together, these features present an investment-style opportunity built around projected returns and recruitment. The records do not independently establish actual mining activity, fulfillment of returns, legality, or completed losses, and the cited material does not resolve those limitations.
